evidence_summary: Iron bisglycinate is one supplemental iron form, but treatment decisions still depend on iron status and clinical context.
Fatigue alone is not evidence of iron deficiency.
BASIC should not create therapeutic iron regimens without appropriate laboratory/clinical context.
personalization: Determine whether formulation-specific evidence differs from parent ingredient; no unvalidated dose conversion or automatic clinical claim.
